A supported, isolated, actually observed mutation that leaves the selected test passing falsifies the guarantee; for a passing candidate, an incomplete falsifier population or a supported falsifier that is neither detected nor such a survivor is not executable, and a failed candidate gains no mutation counterevidence from its falsifier rows.
